decisive_items: At 12 months: En face OCT revealed hyperreflective tissues starting to proliferate on retinal vessels; OCTA B-scan showed pyramid-shaped proliferations
Performed at 21 months showing dendritic vascular-like structures
response.rationale: R1 is preferred due to the combination of the patient's response to anti-VEGF injections and the progression of neovascularization on OCTA and fluorescein angiography

rejected.why: Initial resolution of macular edema does not strongly support Exudative (Wet) Age-related Macular Degeneration
